headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for YS7 Open Platform.

name.description: Plugin name as displayed in the Homebridge log.

videoProcessor.description: The video processor used to decode and play video streams and record segments of video clips. Default is ffmpeg.

skipOfflineDevices.description: Interval (in seconds) to poll zone player.  Default: disabled.

pollingInterval.description: How often (in seconds) to poll devices for data updates (e.g., battery, indicator). 0 disables polling. Default: 60 seconds.
pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval

webhookPath.description: Path for the local webhook server (must start with /). Leave empty to disable.
webhookPath.title: Webhook path

webhookPort.description: Port for the local webhook server. Leave empty to disable.
webhookPort.title: Webhook port

webhookSecret.description: Secret used to verify/decrypt webhook payload (HmacSHA1 with body+timestamp).
webhookSecret.title: Webhook secret

form.title: Credentials
form.description: YS7 open platform app key and app secret. We will use it to retrieve data from the platform.

form.title: Miscellaneous
form.description: You can leave them as default or change them if you know exactly what they are and how they work.
